            ```python
def choose_action(car_position, car_velocity):
    if car_position < -0.5 or (car_position < 0.4 and car_velocity < 0.2):
        return 2
    elif car_position >= -0.5 and car_position < 0.5 and car_velocity > 0.2:
        return 1
    elif car_position >= 0.4 and car_velocity < 0.2:
        return 2
    else:
        return 1
```
